companyFieldUpdates.description: Pacifico Sur is the operating toll-road concession held through Concesionaria Autopista Guadalajara Tepic, S.A. de C.V. (CAGT). Its 309.6-kilometer network in Jalisco and Nayarit includes the Guadalajara–Tepic toll road, the South Guadalajara Bypass and the Tepic Bypass, serving freight, tourism and other toll-paying road users under a long-duration user-pay concession. A definitive agreement was announced on October 2, 2018 and the direct purchase of 49% of CAGT closed on May 15, 2019, leaving IDEAL with 51%, CPP Investments with 29% and Ontario Teachers' with 20%. A 2020 modification extended the concession to 60 years from November 30, 2011, implying expiry in November 2071. Pacifico Sur remains a separate direct PortCo from IDEAL Group and Autopista Arco Norte, and no later direct-stake sale, concession transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.
